audit_status.source_base: Hebrew source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Draft follows the Hebrew closely, renders the divine name as YHWH, preserves difficult passages (child-burning, large casualty figures, political payments to Assyria). Requires witness review for numeric and titular anomalies and for ambiguous verbs.

verses.restored: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem; and he did not do what was right before YHWH, like David his father.

familiar.text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father:

modern.text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. And unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD.

original.text: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלֹא עָשָׂ֧ה הַיָּשָׁ֛ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּדָוִ֥יד אָבִֽיו

verses.restored: He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and he made molten images for the Baalim.

familiar.text: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.

modern.text: Instead, he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and even made cast images of the Baals.

original.text: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּדַרְכֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְגַ֧ם מַסֵּכ֛וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה לַבְּעָלִֽים

verses.restored: Moreover he burned incense in the Gei ben-Hinnom, and he burned his sons in the fire, according to the abominations of the peoples whom YHWH had cast out before the children of Israel.

familiar.text: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

notes.title: textual-ambiguity
notes.body: Hebrew וַיַּבְעֵר אֶת־בָּנָיו is literal 'he burned his sons'; this may indicate child sacrifice or other ritual/violent burning. Preserved without harmonization.

modern.text: Moreover, Ahaz burned incense in the Valley of Hinnom and sacrificed his sons in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

original.text: וְה֥וּא הִקְטִ֖יר בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן הִנֹּ֑ם וַיַּבְעֵ֤ר אֶת בָּנָיו֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ כְּתֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: He sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

familiar.text: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

modern.text: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree. Aram Defeats Judah (Isaiah 1:1–9)

original.text: וַיְזַבֵּ֧חַ וַיְקַטֵּ֛ר בַּבָּמ֖וֹת וְעַל הַגְּבָע֑וֹת וְתַ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן

verses.restored: Therefore YHWH his God gave him into the hand of the king of Aram; they struck him and carried away a great multitude captive and brought them to Damascus; and he was also given into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.

familiar.text: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

modern.text: So the LORD his God delivered Ahaz into the hand of the king of Aram, who attacked him and took many captives to Damascus. Ahaz was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with great force.

original.text: וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֜הוּ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָיו֮ בְּיַ֣ד מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָם֒ וַיַּ֨כּוּ ב֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁבּ֤וּ מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ שִׁבְיָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַיָּבִ֖יאוּ דַּרְמָ֑שֶׂק וְ֠גַם בְּיַד מֶ֤לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נִתָּ֔ן וַיַּךְ בּ֖וֹ מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה

verses.restored: For Pekah son of Remaliah slew in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day — all were valiant men — because they had forsaken YHWH, the God of their fathers.

familiar.text: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.

notes.title: numeric-signal
notes.body: The large casualty figure is preserved from the Hebrew and flagged for witness verification.

modern.text: For in one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed 120,000 valiant men in Judah. This happened because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers.

original.text: וַיַּהֲרֹג֩ פֶּ֨קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֜הוּ בִּֽיהוּדָ֗ה מֵאָ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד הַכֹּ֣ל בְּנֵי חָ֑יִל בְּעָזְבָ֕ם אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king’s son, and Azrikam the palace officer, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

familiar.text: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king’s son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.

modern.text: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the son of the king, Azrikam the governor of the palace, and Elkanah the second to the king.

original.text: וַֽיַּהֲרֹ֞ג זִכְרִ֣י גִּבּ֣וֹר אֶפְרַ֗יִם אֶת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאֶת עַזְרִיקָ֖ם נְגִ֣יד הַבָּ֑יִת וְאֶת אֶלְקָנָ֖ה מִשְׁנֵ֥ה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: And the sons of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters; and they took much spoil and brought the spoil to Samaria.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

modern.text: Then the Israelites took 200,000 captives from their kinsmen—women, sons, and daughters. They also carried off a great deal of plunder and brought it to Samaria.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ֩ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל מֵֽאֲחֵיהֶ֜ם מָאתַ֣יִם אֶ֗לֶף נָשִׁים֙ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֔וֹת וְגַם שָׁלָ֥ל רָ֖ב בָּזְז֣וּ מֵהֶ֑ם וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֶת הַשָּׁלָ֖ל לְשֹׁמְרֽוֹן

verses.restored: But there was there a prophet of YHWH, whose name was Oded; he went out before the army that came to Samaria and said to them, 'Behold, because YHWH the God of your fathers was angry with Judah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage that reaches to heaven.'

familiar.text: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.

modern.text: But a prophet of the LORD named Oded was there, and he went out to meet the army that returned to Samaria. “Look,” he said to them, “because of His wrath against Judah, the LORD, the God of your fathers, has delivered them into your hand. But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches up to heaven.

original.text: וְ֠שָׁם הָיָ֨ה נָבִ֥יא לַֽיהוָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד שְׁמוֹ֒ וַיֵּצֵ֗א לִפְנֵ֤י הַצָּבָא֙ הַבָּ֣א לְשֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם הִ֠נֵּה בַּחֲמַ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה נְתָנָ֣ם בְּיֶדְכֶ֑ם וַתַּֽהַרְגוּ בָ֣ם בְזַ֔עַף עַ֥ד לַשָּׁמַ֖יִם הִגִּֽיעַ

verses.restored: And now you intend to make the children of Judah and Jerusalem your slaves and bondwomen; are there not with you your own sins against YHWH your God?

familiar.text: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?

modern.text: And now you intend to reduce to slavery the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem. But are you not also guilty before the LORD your God?

original.text: וְ֠עַתָּה בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֤ה וִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים לִכְבֹּ֛שׁ לַעֲבָדִ֥ים וְלִשְׁפָח֖וֹת לָכֶ֑ם הֲלֹ֤א רַק אַתֶּם֙ עִמָּכֶ֣ם אֲשָׁמ֔וֹת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Now therefore hear me, and return the captives again whom you have taken of your brothers; for the fierce wrath of YHWH is upon you.

familiar.text: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD is upon you.

modern.text: Now therefore, listen to me and return the captives you took from your kinsmen, for the fierce anger of the LORD is upon you.”

original.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה שְׁמָע֔וּנִי וְהָשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ הַשִּׁבְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁבִיתֶ֖ם מֵאֲחֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֛י חֲר֥וֹן אַף יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Then certain of the heads of the men of Ephraim — Azariah son of Johanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai — stood up against those coming from the war.

familiar.text: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

modern.text: Then some of the leaders of the Ephraimites —Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—stood in opposition to those arriving from the war.

original.text: וַיָּקֻ֨מוּ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵרָאשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי אֶפְרַ֗יִם עֲזַרְיָ֤הוּ בֶן יְהֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּרֶכְיָ֣הוּ בֶן מְשִׁלֵּמ֔וֹת וִֽיחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן שַׁלֻּ֔ם וַעֲמָשָׂ֖א בֶּן חַדְלָ֑י עַל הַבָּאִ֖ים מִן הַצָּבָֽא

verses.restored: They said to them, 'You shall not bring the captives here; for whereas we have offended YHWH already, you intend to add to our sins and to our trespass; for our trespass is great and the fierce wrath is upon Israel.'

familiar.text: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD already, ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.

modern.text: “You must not bring the captives here,” they said, “for you are proposing to bring guilt upon us from the LORD and to add to our sins and our guilt. For our guilt is great, and fierce anger is upon Israel.”

original.text: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם לֹא תָבִ֤יאוּ אֶת הַשִּׁבְיָה֙ הֵ֔נָּה כִּי֩ לְאַשְׁמַ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה עָלֵ֨ינוּ֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים לְהֹסִ֥יף עַל חַטֹּאתֵ֖ינוּ וְעַל אַשְׁמָתֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי רַבָּ֤ה אַשְׁמָה֙ לָ֔נוּ וַחֲר֥וֹן אָ֖ף עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

familiar.text: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

modern.text: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the leaders and all the assembly.

original.text: וַיַּעֲזֹ֣ב הֶֽחָל֗וּץ אֶת הַשִּׁבְיָה֙ וְאֶת הַבִּזָּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַשָּׂרִ֖ים וְכָל הַקָּהָֽל

verses.restored: And the men who were named rose up and took the captives; with the spoil they clothed all that were naked among them, arrayed and shod them, gave them food and drink, anointed them and set the feeble on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren; then they returned to Samaria.

familiar.text: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

modern.text: Then the men who were designated by name arose, took charge of the captives, and provided from the plunder clothing for the naked. They clothed them, gave them sandals and food and drink, anointed their wounds, and put all the feeble on donkeys. So they brought them to Jericho, the City of Palms, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria. The Idolatry of Ahaz (2 Kings 16:10–20)

original.text: וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֩ אֲשֶׁר נִקְּב֨וּ בְשֵׁמ֜וֹת וַיַּחֲזִ֣יקוּ בַשִּׁבְיָ֗ה וְכָֽל מַעֲרֻמֵּיהֶם֮ הִלְבִּ֣ישׁוּ מִן הַשָּׁלָל֒ וַיַּלְבִּשׁ֣וּם וַ֠יַּנְעִלוּם וַיַּאֲכִל֨וּם וַיַּשְׁק֜וּם וַיְסֻכ֗וּם וַיְנַהֲל֤וּם בַּחֲמֹרִים֙ לְכָל כּוֹשֵׁ֔ל וַיְבִיא֛וּם יְרֵח֥וֹ עִיר הַתְּמָרִ֖ים אֵ֣צֶל אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּשׁ֖וּבוּ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן

verses.restored: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria for help.

familiar.text: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.

modern.text: At that time King Ahaz sent for help from the king of Assyria.

original.text: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא שָׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ אָחָ֛ז עַל מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר לַעְזֹ֥ר לֽוֹ

verses.restored: And again the Edomites came and struck Judah and carried away captives.

familiar.text: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.

modern.text: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away captives.

original.text: וְע֥וֹד אֲדוֹמִ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַיַּכּ֥וּ בִיהוּדָ֖ה וַיִּשְׁבּוּ שֶֽׁבִי

verses.restored: The Philistines also raided the cities of the lowland and the Negeb of Judah and took Beth-shemesh, Ajalon, Gederoth, Socho and their villages, Timnah and their villages, Gimzo and their villages; and they dwelt there.

familiar.text: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.

modern.text: The Philistines had also raided the cities of the foothills and the Negev of Judah, capturing and occupying Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, and Gederoth, as well as Soco, Timnah, and Gimzo with their villages.

original.text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים פָּשְׁט֗וּ בְּעָרֵ֨י הַשְּׁפֵלָ֣ה וְהַנֶּגֶב֮ לִֽיהוּדָה֒ וַֽ֠יִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת בֵּֽית שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ וְאֶת אַיָּל֜וֹן וְאֶת הַגְּדֵר֗וֹת וְאֶת שׂוֹכ֤וֹ וּבְנוֹתֶ֨יהָ֙ וְאֶת תִּמְנָ֣ה וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת גִּמְז֖וֹ וְאֶת בְּנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ שָֽׁם

verses.restored: For YHWH brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had made Judah naked and transgressed greatly against YHWH.

familiar.text: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD.

notes.title: titular-note
notes.body: Hebrew calls Ahaz 'king of Israel' here; preserved as in source — requires witness check for editorial intent.

modern.text: For the LORD humbled Judah because Ahaz king of Israel had thrown off restraint in Judah and had been most unfaithful to the LORD.

original.text: כִּֽי הִכְנִ֤יעַ יְהוָה֙ אֶת יְהוּדָ֔ה בַּעֲב֖וּר אָחָ֣ז מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י הִפְרִ֨יעַ֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וּמָע֥וֹל מַ֖עַל בַּיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Then Tilgath‑pilneser king of Assyria came to him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

familiar.text: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

modern.text: Then Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came to Ahaz but afflicted him rather than strengthening him.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֣א עָלָ֔יו תִּלְּגַ֥ת פִּלְנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיָּ֥צַר ל֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א חֲזָקֽוֹ

verses.restored: For Ahaz gave a present from the house of YHWH and from the house of the king and of the princes into the hand of the king of Assyria; but he helped him not.

familiar.text: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the LORD, and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.

modern.text: Although Ahaz had taken a portion from the house of the LORD, from the royal palace, and from the princes and had presented it to the king of Assyria, it did not help him.

original.text: כִּֽי חָלַ֤ק אָחָז֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶת בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִ֑ים וַיִּתֵּן֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְלֹ֥א לְעֶזְרָ֖ה לֽוֹ

verses.restored: And in the time of his distress he trespassed yet more against YHWH — it was King Ahaz.

familiar.text: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD: this is that king Ahaz.

modern.text: In the time of his distress, King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the LORD.

original.text: וּבְעֵת֙ הָצֵ֣ר ל֔וֹ וַיּ֖וֹסֶף לִמְע֣וֹל בַּיהוָ֑ה ה֖וּא הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אָחָֽז

verses.restored: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus who had struck him, and he said, 'Because the gods of the kings of Aram help them, I will sacrifice to them that they may help me.' And they were to him a snare and to all Israel.

familiar.text: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.

modern.text: Since Damascus had defeated him, he sacrificed to their gods and said, “Because the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them, I will sacrifice to them that they may help me.” But these gods were the downfall of Ahaz and of all Israel.

original.text: וַיִּזְבַּ֗ח לֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י דַרְמֶשֶׂק֮ הַמַּכִּ֣ים בּוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כִּ֠י אֱלֹהֵ֤י מַלְכֵֽי אֲרָם֙ הֵ֚ם מַעְזְרִ֣ים אוֹתָ֔ם לָהֶ֥ם אֲזַבֵּ֖חַ וְיַעְזְר֑וּנִי וְהֵ֛ם הָֽיוּ ל֥וֹ לְהַכְשִׁיל֖וֹ וּלְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: And Ahaz gathered the vessels of the house of God, cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, shut the doors of the house of YHWH, and he made for himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

familiar.text: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

modern.text: Then Ahaz gathered up the articles of the house of God, cut them into pieces, shut the doors of the house of the LORD, and set up altars of his own on every street corner in Jerusalem.

original.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֨ף אָחָ֜ז אֶת כְּלֵ֣י בֵית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים וַיְקַצֵּץ֙ אֶת כְּלֵ֣י בֵית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיִּסְגֹּ֖ר אֶת דַּלְת֣וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּ֨עַשׂ ל֧וֹ מִזְבְּח֛וֹת בְּכָל פִּנָּ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: And in every city and town of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and he provoked YHWH, the God of his fathers, to anger.

familiar.text: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.

modern.text: In every city of Judah he built high places to offer incense to other gods, and so he provoked the LORD, the God of his fathers.

original.text: וּבְכָל עִ֨יר וָעִ֤יר לִֽיהוּדָה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה בָמ֔וֹת לְקַטֵּ֖ר לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַיַּכְעֵ֕ס אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

familiar.text: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

modern.text: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaz and all his ways, from beginning to end, they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

original.text: וְיֶ֤תֶר דְּבָרָיו֙ וְכָל דְּרָכָ֔יו הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: So Ahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem — for they did not bring him to the tombs of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

familiar.text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

modern.text: And Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel. And his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב אָחָ֜ז עִם אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֤הוּ בָעִיר֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּ֚י לֹ֣א הֱבִיאֻ֔הוּ לְקִבְרֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְחִזְקִיָּ֥הֽוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו
